htmlPreview.browserLocation: HTML previews open in the sidebar browser. Use the globe button to open this preview.
htmlPreview.localOnly: Embedded content only. Scripts run when generation finishes; external resources and network requests are blocked.
htmlPreview.title: HTML preview

webHostPending.description: Approve this browser on {{name}}: open the request in Cocurdex there and enter this safety code.
webHostPending.title: Waiting for approval
webHostPending.waiting: This page opens by itself once the computer approves it. The request expires after 10 minutes.

webHostUnreachable.forgetFailed: This browser couldn't remove the pairing. Allow site data and try again.
webHostUnreachable.offline: {{name}} isn't connected to its relay. Open Cocurdex on that computer, then try again.
webHostUnreachable.revoked: {{name}} no longer accepts this browser. Forget it here, then pair again with a new link.
webHostUnreachable.title: Can't reach your computer
webHostUnreachable.unreachable: The connection to {{name}} closed before it was set up. Try again, or forget this computer and pair again with a new link.

webPair.description: On your computer, turn on a relay in Cocurdex Settings › Devices, create a pairing code, and paste its link here.

failure.insecure: This relay doesn't use HTTPS, so this page can't connect to it.
failure.invalid: This pairing link has expired, was already used, or is incomplete.
failure.notRelay: The browser connects only through a relay. Turn on a relay on your computer and create a new pairing code.
failure.offline: The computer isn't connected to its relay. Open Cocurdex on it and try again.
failure.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
failure.storage: This browser can't store the pairing. Turn off private browsing or allow site data, then try again.
failure.unreachable: Can't reach the computer through its relay. Check that it is online.

webPair.title: Pair with your computer
